$comment: The API calls of openboxes-mobile (src/apis/*.ts and the src/data code that calls them) at mobile.sha, each with the response fields the app reads. Maintained by hand: update it when the app's API calls change. Paths are relative to apiBase; `{x}` is a value the app fills from expression x. Response field paths are relative to the JSON body (ApiClient returns the body): `a.b` nests, `a[]` is every element, `a["b.c"]` is ONE flat key containing dots. Types are |-joined JSON kinds (string number boolean object array null absent).
